core_meaning.primary_meaning: Baqir is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who splits open [knowledge]”.

core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Baqir corresponds to the Arabic form باقر (ب ق ر). Its core sense is baqir (splitter of knowledge). Bāqir ('one who splits open [knowledge]'), the epithet of Muḥammad al-Bāqir (677-732), the fifth Imam in Shia Islam. The source record's gloss 'One who has a lot of knowledge' is a reasonable rendering.
